text: When buying things, the price tag says it's on sale, but we need to check what's on sale, the color, the scent, and the barcode. Sometimes it's the same type of product but with different scents. Check the barcode to make sure the discount matches the item you picked up. I once saw an item on sale but didn't check the color and barcode, and when I went to pay, the discount wasn't applied. They said I picked the wrong item. It has to be the specific item that's discounted. Instead of buying the discounted item, you might end up paying the regular price. Focus on checking the barcode of the item that's on sale.
